meta.title: Saad Bin Waqas, drones, robots, race cars and code
meta.description: Saad Bin Waqas models, simulates, builds, flies and automates machines in Lahore, Pakistan: FPV drones, sumo robots, a Race Pakistan car, Unity games and software.

hero.sub: Drones, robots, a race car, games and software, from a bench in Lahore.

about.title: From cardboard to carbon fibre

left.label: Where it started
left.title: Cardboard
left.text: My first competition robots were popsicle sticks, corrugated cardboard and an Arduino. One of them won a soccer final.

image.alt: Top view of a four-wheeled robot made of popsicle sticks and cardboard, with an Arduino, a motor driver and a LiPo battery

right.label: Where it is now
right.title: Carbon fibre
right.text: Now it is carbon fibre, CAD and simulation: FPV quads, a CO2 race car in Onshape, and an airframe in Gazebo before any of it gets cut.

about.statement: I work with a team now, often out of CETC, the Crescent Emerging Technologies Centre in Lahore. The method has not changed: pick something we cannot build yet, draw it, simulate it, then build it.

ship.title: Automate
ship.intro: Software for people in Pakistan who sell things and need them to arrive.

codshield.name: CODShield
codshield.text: Most online orders here are paid in cash at the door. When nobody opens it, the seller pays the courier both ways and gets nothing. CODShield is a back office that spots those orders before the parcel leaves.

points.title: Chat that takes the order
points.text: In English, Urdu or Roman Urdu. Prices and stock come from the database, never from the AI or the customer.

points.title: Address cleaning
points.text: Tidies Pakistani addresses using a list of local areas and spellings.

points.title: Risk score with reasons
points.text: Simple, readable rules. Every score is saved with why.

points.title: A human when it matters
points.text: Shaky orders get a confirmation call. If the AI is stuck, staff take over the chat.

chimera.title: Chimera
chimera.teaser: One machine that drives, floats, flies and hovers.
chimera.story: A car, a boat, a plane and a quadcopter, in one airframe. It got as far as a full CAD model and a Gazebo run. It did not get built, because the money ran out before the parts list did.

modes.title: Car
modes.text: Drums down, rotors idle. It drives itself to where it is needed and burns almost nothing doing it.

modes.title: Boat
modes.text: Floats under the booms, front rotors leaned forward. Water stops being an edge on the map.

modes.title: Plane
modes.text: Front rotors tilt all the way, the wing takes the weight, and the range goes up.

modes.title: Quadcopter
modes.text: Rotors up. Straight off a rooftop, then it stays exactly where you tell it to.

chapters.title: Why carry four machines?
chapters.text: Every job had its own vehicle, and each one was useless the moment the ground changed. The idea was to build the one that did not care.

chapters.title: First lines
chapters.text: The document in Onshape is called Mini_VTOL. The first sketch fixed the numbers: a 1.6 metre wing, booms 750 mm apart, a 900 mm tail, three motor mounts.

chapters.title: It gets a body
chapters.text: Aerofoil wing, two booms, twin fins. The front arms rotate so the same motors lift and pull. Hollow drums went on as wheels, big enough to float.

chapters.title: It meets gravity
chapters.text: The airframe went into Gazebo to see how it sat and where it wanted to tip. The centre of mass moved more than once.

chapters.title: The last version
chapters.text: A pod in the middle for the battery and cargo, cleaner joints, and a plan view that finally looked like an aircraft.

chapters.title: Then we priced it
chapters.text: Motors, speed controllers, packs, carbon tube, servos strong enough to tilt a spinning rotor. No cheaper list could still do all four jobs, so we stopped.

chapters.title: The crate is not empty
chapters.text: The CAD, the Gazebo model, and a very clear idea of what four jobs cost. If the budget turns up, so does Chimera.

race.title: Race
race.lead: A race car the length of a hand, pushed by one CO2 cartridge. Air is the whole problem.
race.text: Race Pakistan is a national student competition: design a miniature car, machine it, defend it in front of judges, then race it down a 20 metre track. My team is in for 2027, and the car is being drawn in Onshape.
race.stand: Drawn to the 2027 rules. The real one is still in CAD.
